basics.name: Bui Hoang Anh
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer
basics.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 8+ years of experience building fintech and insurtech platforms end to end, from TypeScript/Node.js and React applications to the cloud infrastructure they run on. Strong in system design, database architecture and infrastructure as code. Works closely with product, operations and external partners to turn business requirements into stable, scalable systems.

highlights.description: Developed core backend features and third-party integrations for the loan origination platform.
Owned DevOps for the new platform version: built its infrastructure as code with Terraform to keep the system stable and scalable as the company grew.
Drove the migration of the platform from AWS to Google Cloud and strengthened its cloud security.
Standardised CI/CD pipelines across services, reducing build time and cost.
Worked across engineering teams to resolve production problems and advised teammates on technical solutions that improved the product.
